headline: SIA Engineering First-Half Profit Falls 1.7% to $81.9M on Lower Revenue
summary: SIA Engineering reported a 1.7% decline in first-half net profit to $81.9 million as revenue fell nearly 10%, and declared an interim dividend of 2.5 cents a share.
why: SIA Engineering provides maintenance, repair, and overhaul services to commercial airlines, reflecting broader operational trends in the aviation sector.

impacts.name: SIA Engineering
impacts.why: Lower net profit and revenue directly reflect reduced financial performance.
